issues.title: Proposal: an audit explain output
issues.body:
This is a proposal, not a feature this release provides.

`re audit --json` stores the totals, the method, the blame flags, and the counts. It does not store, for each classified commit, the commit SHA, the agent, the classification evidence, or that commit's introduced and surviving line counts. `re why`, `re trace`, and `re lens` read the local ledger. They do not explain why a remote audit classified a commit.

SNTL84 suggested `re audit --explain` after checking external repositories with 0.4.0. A useful output would list, for each metadata-matched commit, the SHA, the agent, the evidence the classifier already produced, and the introduced and surviving counts. Absence of a git AI tag would remain what it is now: no signal of that kind, not proof that a person wrote the code. The output would not store `refs/notes/ai`.

No such output is implemented.

issues.title: Unreproduced message before a successful clone
issues.body:
On the distributed Windows 0.4.0 build, the first remote audit showed an error before the repository was cloned. The clone then finished and the audit completed. The command output was not included, so this report is not reproduced.

SNTL84, if you still have it, please add two things on this issue:

- the exact command that was typed
- the exact message shown before the clone succeeded

Until those lines are here, there is nothing further to attribute the message to. This issue does not say that the message is fixed.

openWork.title: Connect Crovia research to external needs and actual-use feedback
openWork.body:
The resident currently reasons mostly from its own source and unverified internal hypotheses. Give it a bounded read-only external issue queue and an actual-use feedback path.

Public GitHub searches fetch canonical open issues after checking repository visibility. Source URLs, timestamps, hashes and excerpts are retained. Ranking is an explicit topic heuristic: it filters own-project echoes, old evidence, unrelated-title boilerplate and three repeated attempts on unchanged evidence in recent history. It is not validated demand. Source selection must match an id supplied to the scout; failure to retrieve evidence remains an error, never a fictional opportunity.

The writer retains opportunities.json and growth/<episode>.json connecting source, hypothesis, falsifier, checks and candidate. Agent trial issues feed research as unverified self-reports. The updated mission favors useful code, falsifiable experiments, reproducible feedback and actual task reuse rather than content volume.

Add an actual-task onboarding guide using the existing re audit JSON interface. Both projects get an optional inbound issue form. Opening or reopening an [Agent trial] issue can wake research, throttled
